basics.description: Configure OutThink Direct Mail Injection App deployment. **Note:** Only the Key Vault URL is required.

basics.name: sku

basics.toolTip: Available Linux App Service Plan SKUs for the selected subscription and region. P0v3 is the recommended minimum.
